source: Pew Research Center. India Religion Survey, fielded November 17, 2019-March 23, 2020.
method: Population is the respondent's own religion (QRELSING), restricted to respondents actually asked Q63c - the survey skips a respondent's own religion in its neighbor-acceptance battery, so Christian respondents (N=1,011) were never asked whether they'd accept a Christian neighbor. Share answering "yes" to Q63c ("Would you be willing to accept a Christian as a neighbor?"); "other/both/neither/depends," don't know, and refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own weight variable.
